它并非传统知识库或文档集合，而是一套可落地的现场部署操作系统。系统整合 FDE 领域经验、方法论、工具、模板、执行脚本、实战案例以及自我迭代机制，搭建起一套可执行的工作体系，保障每一次现场交付都能够实现系统化推进、标准化落地、可复制复用。
Full‑stack Workbench for Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE). It covers the full‑link workflow including on‑site diagnosis, constrained solution design, rapid prototyping, AI deployment, technical troubleshooting, knowledge replication and cross‑industry migration.
This workbench fits scenarios such as AI product delivery, on‑site customer deployment, POC sprint, production troubleshooting and large‑scale replication. Trigger keywords: FDE, Forward‑Deployed Engineering, on‑site delivery, AI landing diagnosis, POC sprint, deployment troubleshooting, knowledge replication, cross‑industry migration, delivery engineer.
Positioning of FDE Forward Deployed Engineer Expert System: Equipped with this capability, one engineer can finish end‑to‑end delivery from diagnosis and solution formulation to prototype implementation at customer sites within 48 hours, and achieve large‑scale business replication within 90 days.
Rather than a conventional knowledge base or document library, it is a practical on‑site deployment operating system. It integrates FDE domain experience, methodologies, tools, templates, playbooks, real‑world cases and self‑iteration mechanisms to build an actionable workflow system, ensuring every on‑site delivery can be systematically managed, standardized and replicable.

skills.description_zh:
方法论 Skill：帮助律师把自有法律文书母版变量化，建成可传承的母版库。本 Skill 聚焦委托材料的母版化场景——将委托代理合同、授权委托书、风险告知书等律所自有模板变量化入库，此后上传笔录、录音或输入案件信息，一次确认即可成套生成。

Skill 核心功能：
1. 辅助教学：全程引导式教学，对 AI 零基础的律师也无使用负担，学会后自己就能维护母版库；
2. 信息脱敏：内置脱敏审核程序，自动识别敏感信息生成脱敏清单，保护导入的案件隐私；谈话录音本地转写，不出律所电脑；
3. 变量自动识别：内置法律文书识别规则，导入模板自动精准识别变量，生成格式与律所原模板一字不动；
4. 输入方式多样：支持文字（对话、笔录、起诉状）与录音等多种方式输入案件信息；
5. 方法论可外溢：同一套「模板变量化」方法，可迁移到起诉状、法律顾问合同、执行申请等任何高频文书场景。

模板资产始终归贵所，不随 Skill 分享。触发词：委托材料、委托材料模板、委托材料包、模板库搭建、委托材料生成、风险告知笔录、委托手续。
